title: GreenPeach: Clean, Doctor-Formulated Liquid Supplements for Modern Families
text:
Founded by Industry Experts and a Mother’s Mission for Better Nutrition
(PRUnderground) April 9th, 2025
Established in 2017 under its parent company, GreenPeach is proud to announce its official introduction to a broader audience. Located in Fullerton, CA, GreenPeach is redefining family wellness through premium, clean-label liquid and powder supplements designed for children, moms, and families.
Born from over two decades of experience in food testing, manufacturing, and quality assurance, CEO Feryal Talebdoost founded GreenPeach with a singular mission: to build a trustworthy supplement brand that prioritizes health over profit.
Drawing from personal experiences as a mother, and guided by wisdom from her own mother—a midwife and OB nurse—Feryal saw firsthand the gaps in the supplement industry. She responded by assembling a team of physicians, nutritionists, chemists, and logistics experts to develop bioavailable, effective, and clean formulations.
“GreenPeach was created out of love and concern for families everywhere,” says CEO Feryal Talebdoost. “Our products are a direct answer to the nutritional challenges modern families face—made for busy parents who want to nourish their kids without compromise.”
GreenPeach’s lineup includes:
- Liquid Vegan Vitamin D3 is praised for its purity and infant-friendly delivery
- Immune Boost with organic elderberry syrup, designed even for picky eaters
- Liquid Omega 3 with DHA & EPA for brain development and palatability
- Liquid Iron Supplement, known for being gentle on tiny tummies
- Prenatal Whole Food Nutrient Formula, no-nausea, easy-to-mix, and mom-approved
Unlike many brands, GreenPeach refuses to add artificial colors, flavors, or preservatives, focusing exclusively on liquid and powder formats for optimal absorption and customizability. All products are manufactured in FDA-registered facilities and are non-GMO, gluten-free, USDA organic, kosher, halal, and sustainable.
“We do the research so parents don’t have to,” adds Talebdoost. “Our commitment to transparency, science-backed formulation, and doctor validation is what sets GreenPeach apart.”
For more information, visit www.greenpeach.com and follow GreenPeach on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest at @greenpeachvitamins.
About GreenPeach
Founded in 2017, GreenPeach is a family-focused wellness company offering clean, doctor-formulated liquid and powder supplements for children, moms, and families. Headquartered in Fullerton, California, GreenPeach was born from a mother’s mission to provide safer, more effective nutritional solutions in a market lacking transparency. With a commitment to purity, science-backed formulas, and expert collaboration, GreenPeach delivers supplements that support long-term wellness—not just trends. All products are non-GMO, USDA Organic, Kosher, Halal, gluten-free, and manufactured in FDA-registered facilities. Trusted by parents and approved by professionals, GreenPeach makes nutrition easy, honest, and accessible. For more information, visit www.greenpeach.com and follow GreenPeach on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Pinterest at @greenpeachvitamins.
